criterion: Creates a design document under docs/plans/ (or complete design specification in the response) without modifying production files in gatekeeper/.
References gatekeeper/router.py (RequestRouter, TenantPolicy, DispatchOutcome) and explains how concurrent slow requests saturate the global pool despite minute-window counters.
Compares at least two isolation approaches (such as per-tenant in-flight bulkheads with reserved capacity vs weighted fair queuing vs adaptive concurrency limits) with clear trade-offs.
Defines how idle capacity is shared during low load while guaranteeing a minimum reserved concurrency floor or cap per tenant under contention.
Outlines deterministic test cases covering noisy-neighbor saturation, burst admission, and recovery when in-flight requests complete.
